title.narrative: Soil Health for Sustainable Agri-Food Systems transformation in Africa

description.narrative: Support to Auda-Nepad for coordination and support to AU member states in following up on resolutions from the African Fertilizer and Soil Health Summit AFSH (May 2024). This includes development of national Action plans for soil health to promote implementations of soil health interventions with overall aim of improved soil fertility, increased efficiency in agriculture and food security. Soil health interventions are key in ensuring climate change adaptation and advise related to crop selection and management aswell as potential for reduced carbon emissions from soil as soil is a major carbon sink and for carbon sequestration thereby an important factor in the work on soil health.
